source_type: Frozen official HTML catalogue historical quotations; TEI fetch did not succeed.
text_normalization_policy: Raw HTML text slices retained; display collapses HTML whitespace only. Secondary name-component fields are explicit derivatives. No u/v, i/j, case, spelling, abbreviation or editorial-bracket normalization.
punctuation_policy: Quotation-internal punctuation comes from the modern catalogue presentation; it is not certified manuscript punctuation. Broken opening quotation marks do not cause dropped entries.
rights_note_zh: 历史拉丁文本属早期文献；本提取依据 Walters 现代目录转写，保留其编辑补字。目录标示 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0，目录原文全文和现代英语翻译/评论仅私有保存；公开仅历史转写、来源定位、中文自写摘要与核查代码，并注明来源。
